content:
lina: Quick ping— planning a low-risk nightdrop to publish 1.5.0-rc.0 for py/ts. Will push a short-lived dist-tag for integration partners. Rolling in 20m. objections?
kevin: all good. what's the canary tag?
lia (ria): suggest `integration-rc-2026-03-21` to keep it distinct from prior ephemeral tags.
sam: agree. please ensure changelog and npm `deprecated` fields updated for the sync client package.
lina: will do. publish plan: 1) run wheel build -> testpypi 2) npm pack + publish to registry with `--tag integration-rc-2026-03-21` 3) set pip alias 4) run integration smoke and perf harness. rollback if any auth error or checksum drift.
deploy-bot: [483220-483221] publish job queued: py(jb_48322) / npm(nb_48322)
kevin: rollback SLA: immediate yank on any pypi 403 or `checksum-mismatch` from deploy-bot. For runtime, revert if 5xx > 0.7% or median latency increase >200ms in first 10m.
julie: added small test in prow to pin `@redwood/sdk` to the RC in the webapp e2e. posted PR.
ria: deprecation blurb ready: "Deprecation: package `@redwood/sdk-sync` is deprecated. Migrate to `@redwood/sdk` async client. Migration guide: https://redwood.ai/migrate-sync. Scheduled removal: 90 days."
lina: preflight checklist: - changelog updated - package.json "deprecated" for sync package - dist-tag name reserved - checksums created and signed - prow pin in place
deploy-bot: [483221-483222] py publish -> testpypi SUCCESS (jb_48322). sha256: def456...
kevin: good. starting npm publish now.
deploy-bot: [483222-483223] npm publish (nb_48322) FAILED: checksum mismatch when writing tarball. log: `EINTEGRITY: unexpected hash for package`
ria: hmm, we had a build container that stripped metadata last week. could be differing file order. sam can you re-run `npm pack` locally and verify sha?
sam: on it. re-packed and compared. local tar hash differs from CI artifact. looks like the build script `scripts/pack.sh` is non-deterministic under node16. I'll lock node to 18 for packing in the pipeline.
lina: good catch. For now we'll soft-yank the npm dist-tag and stop exposing the RC until we repack. kev, do we want to keep the wheel on testpypi?
kevin: keep wheels on testpypi visible to integration partners but don't set main `canary`/`integration` tags until JS artifact stable. set npm tag to `staged-integration-rc` temporarily if we need visibility but don't advertise.
julie: I updated release board with blocked -> packaging flake. added owner: sam.
sam: repacked with node18, pushed new artifact, re-running publish job.
deploy-bot: [483223-483224] npm publish (nb_48322) RESTARTED -> SUCCESS. dist-tag set: integration-rc-2026-03-21
ria: running quick smoke against the canary gateway. hooking up e2e pinned to RC.
deploy-bot: [483224-483225] smoke-suite started (is_48322)
kevin: watching metrics: first 3m stable, 0.05% 5xx, median latency +12ms. acceptable.
lina: marketing note: can someone draft a short paragraph noting the sync client deprecation and RC availability? keep it technical.
ria: drafting: "Developer preview: 1.5.0-rc.0 introduces unified async-first SDK. Legacy sync package marked deprecated and scheduled for removal in 90 days. Integration partners can test via dist-tag `integration-rc-2026-03-21`. See migration guide."
julie: good, i'll route to comms.
sam: follow-up tasks: 1) change build pack to node18 for deterministic tar 2) add pack checksum assertion step 3) remove dist-tag after 24h unless promoted
lina: capturing that in the release checklist and creating follow-up tickets.
deploy-bot: [483225-4832205600] smoke-suite COMPLETE: PASS (is_48322). No auth or signer issues.
lina: closing thread. outcome: RC published with `integration-rc-2026-03-21`, initial npm checksum fail mitigated by node upgrade, wheels remain on testpypi. dist-tag to be reconciled in 24h for promotion to `canary`. Thanks all! :party_popper:
